items.title: ECB Plans Direct Investment In Tokenized Securities Using Pontes
items.summary: TL;DR The ECB has started preparatory work to invest a small portion of its own-funds portfolio in tokenized euro-denominated securities. Initial eligible assets are expected to include euro-area public-sector and supranational issuers. The future purchases are intended to settle in central-bank money through Pontes; purchases have not yet been executed. The European Central Bank is moving from building tokenized-settlement infrastructure to preparing to use it for part of its own investment portfolio. items.title: ECB Launches Pontes For Central-Bank Settlement Of Tokenized Assets
items.summary: TL;DR The European Central Bank has launched Pontes, a wholesale settlement service for tokenized financial assets. Pontes settles transactions in central-bank money through TARGET Services and DLT interoperability. The system is institutional infrastructure and is separate from the retail digital-euro project. The European Central Bank has launched Pontes, giving institutions a new route for settling tokenized financial assets in central-bank money.
